title: Flow Play Zoom Styling
description: Fix flow play canvas styling breaking on zoom
summary: Fixed remaining flow/procedural zoom styling bugs: (1) slider_track_bounds returned (left, right, top, bottom) but callers destructured as (left, top, right, bottom), painting the track outside the node box; corrected tuple order and added bounds test. (2) Computation nodes lacked a title header row, so node names overlapped port labels (e.g. brep.sphere over radius); added DAG_COMPUTATION_HEADER_ROWS and paint_computation_node_name in the header band. (3) Strokes and labels used world-fixed widths and zoom-scaled font px, making lines hair-thin and text inconsistent when zooming; switched to screen-constant stroke widths (dag_world_stroke) and fixed 10–11px label size. WASM rebuilt, all 23 dag tests and flow play validate pass.
